name: TC-CL-05: listing heading, filters and cards on Tempo Traveller
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/CategoryPages/CategoryListingCategory.cy.js#CategoryPages - CategoryListing [tempoTraveller] [en] — Tempo Traveller TC-CL-05: listing heading, filters and cards on Tempo Traveller
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-CL-05
**Title:** listing heading, filters and cards on Tempo Traveller
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open Tempo Traveller and confirm the page heading and at least one listing card CTA. Filter By is checked when that row is present.

**Expected Result:**
Page heading is visible and at least one listing card button is shown.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Tempo Traveller page
2. Verify the page heading
3. Verify listing cards (and Filter By when present)
